IP is an official file type. WIR/MIR/NCR numbering is not defined by EAS-6-B and is retained as a project-specific Segment 4 extension.

The file types are official, but EAS-6-B does not define a type-specific numbering grammar for them. The observed three-digit project sequence is preserved.
The data is structurally importable, but EAS-6-B marks PR for deletion and SC for replacement by DR.
